findings.message: GO-01 requires deterministic task attribution through the existing artifact chain, but no acceptance criterion verifies the `obligations.json` target entry → `task-contract.json` task assignment → `impl-plan.json` status composition. AC-01 starts from an already-established lane, so an implementation can satisfy every AC without proving the goal’s attribution mechanism.
findings.category: missing AC coverage for a stated goal

findings.message: GO-02 promises preservation of the fail-closed guarantee, but orphaned bindings have no acceptance criterion for their final gate outcome. AC-03 only checks that orphaned detection is status-independent, while AC-01/AC-02 enumerate blocking behavior only for missing, stale, verdict absence, and structural failures; therefore the stated fail-closed goal is not deterministically proven for orphaned findings.
findings.category: missing AC coverage for a stated goal

findings.message: `domain::ObligationCheckError` declares existing named payloads (`detail`, `drifts`, `edges`) as tuple payloads, diverging from the baseline/post-modification shape.
`usecase::PreReviewGateError` is marked `reference` but its three existing named payloads are declared as tuples instead of the baseline struct fields (`message`, `layer`).
`domain::ObligationCheckError.docs` restates the IN-04 status-independent/fail-closed behavior instead of referring to the upstream anchor only.
`usecase::CheckTestObligationsInteractor.docs` restates the IN-03 detection-versus-final-gate boundary in prose; replace the behavioral contract with anchor-based intent.
`usecase::CheckTestObligationsOutcome` both restates the todo-warning behavior in `docs` and omits IN-07/AC-07 although `status_lane_summaries` carries skipped-lane results.
findings.category: upstream restatement; spec_refs missing or off-topic

findings.message: `usecase::PreReviewGateError.docs` contains design-rationale prose about opaque String diagnostics rather than an anchor-only reference.
`usecase::TestObligationResultsInteractor.docs` restates the IN-05 informational aggregation/pass-fail separation contract instead of referring to anchors only.
`usecase::TestObligationResultsOutput` exposes skipped-capable `status_lane_summaries` but cites only IN-05; add the IN-07/AC-07 skipped-lane grounding.
`usecase::TestObligationStatusLaneSummary` restates the count/usize design rationale and does not cite IN-07/AC-07 even though its TaskStatusKind lane includes Skipped.
findings.category: upstream restatement; spec_refs missing or off-topic

findings.message: `domain::TaskStatusKind` explicitly includes `Skipped` and documents strictest-wins attribution, but its only spec reference is IN-01; add the skipped-lane grounding IN-07/AC-07.
`cli_driver::TestObligationCheckHandler.docs` restates the AC-01/AC-02 gate-warning and blocking contract in prose; use anchor-based intent instead.
`cli_driver::TestObligationResultsHandler.docs` restates the informational/exit-0 contract and lists only three lanes, omitting the independent skipped lane required by AC-07.
`cli_composition::TestObligationCompositionRoot` wires the status-lane attribution path but cites only IN-01/IN-05; add the IN-07/AC-07 skipped-lane grounding.
`TestObligationResultsHandler` documents only todo/in-progress/done lanes, but AC-07/IN-07 require skipped as an independent informational lane. The adapter contract must include skipped.

`CheckTestObligationsInteractor::new` and `TestObligationResultsInteractor::new` declare the same 12-parameter dependency signature. This duplicates the detection dependency contract across sibling interactors and should be factored into a shared dependency bundle.
findings.category: duplicated method signature across sibling types

findings.message: `ObligationCheckError` docs restate the IN-04 behavior (“status-independent ... always block”) instead of describing the changed symbol and citing the upstream contract. This violates `no-upstream-restatement.md`.

`TestObligationCheckHandler` docs restate the todo-warning and strict-lane gate behavior from the spec. Replace the behavioral prose with the changed surface plus anchor citations per `no-upstream-restatement.md`.
`TestObligationResultsHandler` docs restate informational aggregation and always-success read-error behavior from IN-05/AC-05. Use an anchor-only change description instead.
`CheckTestObligationsInteractor` docs restate the status-independence/final-gate boundary from IN-03. The catalogue docs must not reproduce the upstream behavior contract.
`CheckTestObligationsOutcome` docs restate the passing/todo-warning behavior from IN-02 rather than limiting the entry to the changed DTO and anchor citations.
`TestObligationResultsInteractor` docs restate the informational-only/no-gate-decision behavior from IN-05. Replace the prose contract with a concise symbol/change description and citations.

`domain::ObligationCheckError` declares the existing named payload variants `StaleObligationsArtifact`, `DriftsDetected`, `UnresolvedEdges`, and `StaleVerdicts` as tuple payloads, but the baseline uses named struct fields (`detail`/`drifts`/`edges`). This misstates the post-modification public enum shape.
`domain::TaskStatusKind` includes `Skipped` and is documented for strictest-wins attribution, but its only grounding is IN-01, which does not specify the skipped lane. Add IN-07/AC-07 grounding.
`usecase::CheckTestObligationsOutcome` carries `status_lane_summaries`, including the skipped lane, but cites only IN-02. Add IN-07 grounding for the skipped-lane contract.
`usecase::TestObligationResultsOutput` exposes skipped-capable status-lane summaries but cites only IN-05. Add IN-07 grounding for the independent skipped results lane.
`usecase::TestObligationStatusLaneSummary` models `TaskStatusKind` lanes, including `Skipped`, but cites only IN-02/IN-05. Add IN-07 grounding for the skipped lane.
The `TestObligationStatusLaneSummary` docs restate the non-negative-count/`usize` design rationale instead of limiting the catalogue description to the changed type and upstream anchors.
`cli_composition::TestObligationCompositionRoot` wires the task-status attribution path used by the skipped lane but cites only IN-01/IN-05. Add IN-07/AC-07 grounding.
`usecase::TestObligationDetectionDependencies` is a dependency/data carrier, not a use-case behavior type, but declares `role: UseCase`; this misclassifies the type under the role/layer matrix.

`usecase::TestObligationDetectionDependencies` bundles check-only dependencies (rules/source/spec/catalogue/fingerprints) with results dependencies, and `TestObligationResultsInteractor::new` therefore accepts unrelated ports. This violates single responsibility and couples the results interactor to dependencies it does not use.

`usecase::TestObligationStatusLaneSummary` docs restate the upstream design rationale that its `usize` fields represent collection lengths rather than domain values. Catalogue docs should identify the type and cite anchors without reproducing upstream rationale.
`usecase::CheckTestObligationsInteractor` carries skipped-lane interpretation via IN-07, but its `spec_refs` omit the required AC-07 grounding for skipped-lane behavior.
`usecase::CheckTestObligationsOutcome` exposes status-lane summaries including the skipped lane, but its `spec_refs` cite IN-07 without the required AC-07 grounding.
`usecase::TestObligationResultsInteractor` is the results aggregation surface but cites only IN-05/IN-07; it is missing the required AC-05 results grounding and AC-07 skipped-lane grounding.
`usecase::TestObligationResultsOutput` carries the results and skipped status lanes but cites only IN-05/IN-07; it is missing the required AC-05 and AC-07 citations.

`usecase::TestObligationStatusLaneSummary` is shared by the check/results lane surfaces and includes skipped status, but its `spec_refs` omit the required AC-05 results citation and AC-07 skipped-lane citation.

The `plan.summary` field is empty (`"summary": []`), so GO-NN goal-to-task traceability is absent from the impl-plan SSoT. Add the goals and their carrying task IDs.

T001 targets `libs/domain/src/tddd/test_obligation/{errors.rs,vocab.rs}` but claims to update `TaskStatusKind`; that type is in `libs/domain/src/track.rs` and is catalogued as `action: reference`, so the task scope cannot execute the stated change.

`usecase-types.json` declares the `TestObligationDetectionDependencies` catalogue entry (`action: add`, IN-03/IN-05), but `task-contract.json` contains no corresponding usecase attribution. The claimed 15-entry coverage is therefore incomplete and the shared dependency carrier has no owning task.
T006 の「update implementation-batch test-obligation bindings」は対象ファイルまたはシンボルを示しておらず、実装者が変更境界を推測する必要がある。`test-bindings.json` など具体的な対象を記載すべき。
